results.name: the expect arm anchored holds after pathway:anchor and pathway:route (a verdict with the ok document)
the expect arm anchored is false for the other end (ok false, detail says what is anchored)
a dry run with expect: no out, created empty, changed true, the arm true
changed is true when pathway:route moves a displaced arrow
changed is false when pathway:route finds the arrow routed already
pathway:anchor on a plus sign is error.draw2.object (a verdict, stage command)
pathway:anchor on an id that is no object is error.draw2.noObject (a verdict, stage command)
